mechanics.claim: Basic attacks on-hit and abilities against enemy champions apply a mark; a subsequent hit on a marked target consumes it to deal the current-health damage and grant a Mist stack.
mechanics.quote: Subsequent attacks or ability hits against marked targets will consume the mark to grant '''Senna''' a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Mist}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: The mark-consumption damage applies life steal at 100% effectiveness.
mechanics.quote: This damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.

mechanics.claim: Relic Cannon's on-hit damage also applies life steal at 100% effectiveness, but only triggers if the attack deals more than 0 damage.
mechanics.quote: * ''Relic Cannon'' is only applied if the attack deals more than 0 damage.

mechanics.claim: Relic Cannon's damage applies at 100% life steal effectiveness.
mechanics.quote: The damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.

mechanics.claim: Mist stacks grant bonus attack damage continuously (a stacking self-buff), separate from the range/crit-chance tier bonuses.
mechanics.quote: For each stack of {{as|Mist}}, '''Senna''' gains {{sti|attack damage|{{as|{{fd|{{#var:i_ad}}}} '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}
